status.description: Status is the current status of the Session.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Session represents an authenticated session of a User. A User can interact with the Cluster and access its Services only through a valid Session which is automatically created by the Cluster upon a successful authentication. The Cluster issues an access token and a refresh token representing the Session's validity and the User has to periodically re-authenticate to keep the Session valid until it eventually expires and is automatically deleted by the Cluster.

opa.description: OPA contains an OPA (Open Policy Agent) Rego script

octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.title: Inline Policy
octelium.api.main.core.v1.InlinePolicy.description: InlinePolicy is a Policy that is defined inline within the resource that attaches it instead of being created as a standalone Policy resource.

rules.description: Rules is the list of Policy rules

enforcementRules.description: EnforcementRules is the list of enforcement rules that are typically used as a precondition for using the Policy rules. You can simply extract your shared conditions from your rules and write them instead inside enforcementRules for better performance and readability

attrs.description: Attrs is a map of user-defined attributes that can be reused inside the Policy rules. It is strongly recommended to stick to camelCase in order to be conformant with Octelium's API naming conventions.

isDisabled.description: IsDisabled disables (i.e. deactivates) the Policy. You can use this to temporarily disable enforcing the Policy altogether instead of having to delete it or de-attach it from the different Resources attaching it.

condition.description: Condition is the enforcement rule's Condition

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the EnforcementRule once its Condition matches

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.title: Enforcement Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.En.description: EnforcementRule is a pre-condition that decides whether the Policy is evaluated at all. If no EnforcementRule matches, or if the list of EnforcementRules is empty, then the Policy is enforced. ENFORCE rules always override IGNORE rules in the same way that DENY rules override ALLOW rules.

name.description: Name is an optional name for the rule. It is currently useful in Logs to understand which rule triggered the Policy.

condition.description: Condition is the rule's Condition that must match in order for the rule, and subsequently the Policy as whole, to match

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: Effect is the decision of the Rule once its Condition matches

priority.description: Priority is an integer that sets the rule priority level. The lower the number, the higher the priority. Currently the range of numbers is between -4 (i.e. the highest priority) and 4 (i.e. the lowest priority).

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.title: Rule
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Policy.Spec.Ru.description: Rule is a single access control rule of the Policy

service.description: Service means that this is a Service scope

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Scope.description: Scope restricts what a Session is allowed to reach. A Session that carries no Scopes is unrestricted, otherwise it can only reach what its Scopes allow. filter.description: Filter filters access to certain APIs or certain methods of certain APIs

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Spec.A.description: Authorization sets the Policies that are applied to the Session. These Policies are typically copied from the Credential that created the Session upon a successful authentication.

authentication.description: Authentication includes the information of the authentication operation used currently by the Session

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Credential is the information of a Credential-based authentication

clientVersion.description: ClientVersion is the version of the Octelium client

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Identity Provider
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: IdentityProvider is the information of an IdentityProvider-based authentication

lastSeenAt.description: LastSeenAt is the timestamp at which the connected client was last seen by the Cluster

addresses.description: Addresses is the list private addresses used by the connected Session's client

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Connection is the information of the currently connected client of a CLIENT Session

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: PublishedService is a Service that is published to the connected client's host (i.e. reachable locally at the client's side)

requestedServices.description: RequestedServices is the list of the Services that the Session explicitly requested to serve

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: ServiceOptions is the configuration of the Services that the connected Session is willing to serve as upstreams

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: RequestedService is a Service that the Session explicitly requested to serve

l4Type.description: L4Type is the layer-4 protocol of the upstream

namespaceRef.description: NamespaceRef is the reference of the served Service's Namespace

backend.description: Backend is the actual upstream reachable from the connected Session's host

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode is how the upstream is served by the connected Session

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Upstream
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Upstream is a Service that is actually served by the connected Session (i.e. the Session's host reaches the actual upstream on behalf of the Cluster)

host.description: Host is the host of the actual upstream

port.description: Port is the listen port of the actual upstream

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Backend
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: Backend is the actual upstream that is reachable from the connected Session's host

startedAt.description: StartedAt is the timestamp at which the connection started

endedAt.description: EndedAt is the timestamp at which the connection ended

octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.title: Last Connection
octelium.api.main.core.v1.Session.Status.description: LastConnection is the information of a past connection of the Session

v4.description: V4 is the IPv4 network address represented as CIDR notation IP address and prefix length (e.g. `192.0.2.0/24`).

v6.description: V6 is the IPv6 network address represented as CIDR notation IP address and prefix length (e.g. `2001:db8::/32`).

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.DualStackNetwo.title: Dual Stack Network
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.DualStackNetwo.description: DualStackNetwork is a pair of an IPv4 and an IPv6 network range.

milliseconds.description: Milliseconds is the duration set in milliseconds

seconds.description: Seconds is the duration set in seconds

minutes.description: Minutes is the duration set in minutes

hours.description: Hours is the duration set in hours

days.description: Days is the duration set in days

weeks.description: Weeks is the duration set in weeks

months.description: Months is the duration set in months

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.title: Duration
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Duration.description: Duration is a length of time that is expressed in a single unit of choice. Exactly one of the units is set (e.g. `seconds: 30`).

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
